jumped awkwardly . Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & improving Two Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Back to rail & pressured Two Wide @ 300m & chased steadily in last 200m. # OK from rear.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began very awkwardly. Rider reported that rounding the home turn he was momentarily held up for clear running. He added that upon straightening he attempted to improve his mount to a run, however before being able to establish this run, a horse was carried in and rather than continue into a run when there was insufficient room, he directed his mount to the outside whereby his mount finished its race off strongly.
